rules.title: Prohibition on Algorithmic Devices to Set Rents
rules.requirement: Landlords and companies may not sell or use algorithmic software that analyzes nonpublic competitor rental data to recommend rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential rental units in San Francisco; targets algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data to recommend rents or occupancy levels.
rules.penalty: Tenant or City Attorney may bring a civil action against violators.
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of algorithmic devices to set rents or manage occupancy levels for residential units in San Francisco.
